You need to use the v1.4 branch as I've written above.

```

    git clone https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git
    cd MAVSDK
    git switch v1.4
    git submodule update --init --recursive
    cd examples
    cd takeoff_and_land/
    cmake -Bbuild -H.
    cmake --build build -j4

```
To me, it looks like there is an installed MAVSDK via a package or so, otherwise header files would not be used from /usr/include/mavsdk right?

> I think, I have done with that (.deb file ) . So can you provide any documention link or something . I have given lot of time to solve

I'd say it's much easier, and common to just install a library via .deb and then build against it.

Is this MAVSDK library not compatible with this deb version
You should use the latest version v1.4.x

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
I have code that compiled and ran under version 0.30 of MAVSDK.  I did experience some connection inconsistencies with my PIXHAWK MINI and decided to upgrade to the latest release of MAVSDK, as Version 0.33 brought about improvements in this area.  I removed the MAVSDK::mavsdk_action, etc libraries from my CMakeLists.txt and now I get the following error when compiling my code.
`In file included from /usr/local/include/mavsdk/plugins/info/info.h:16,
                 from /home/eric/ros_ws/src/drone/src/drone_node.cpp:46:
/usr/local/include/mavsdk/plugin_base.h:25:61: error: expected constructor, destructor, or type conversion before ‘;’ token
   25 | template<class... Ts> overloaded(Ts...) -> overloaded<Ts...>;
      |                                                             ^
make[2]: *** [CMakeFiles/base_node_lib.dir/build.make:63: CMakeFiles/base_node_lib.dir/src/drone_node.cpp.o] Error 1
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:136: CMakeFiles/base_node_lib.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [Makefile:141: all] Error 2
`
I did not change anything else in my code.  How do I debug this? I get the error if I include any mavsdk header files.  

I am running Ubuntu 20.04 64 bit (Both on a Virtual Box VM and on a Raspberry Pi 4)

Any advice would be appreciated.
